text.p: Typhoon Zane remains a significant threat to shipping as well as to northern Okinawa and the island of Yoron, south of Japan. Zane is currently scraping just north of Okinawa as it moves east at 9 mph. Zane has top winds near 100 mph but is weakening, however it will still be a fairly strong storm as it moves across Yoron during the next several hours. Zane will continue to weaken and will begin to lose tropical characteristics during the next couple days while moving into the waters south southeast of Japan.

Typhon Yates, with top winds near 100 mph, is centered about 120 miles northwest of Chichijima in the western Pacific, moving north northeast at 20 mph. Yates will steadily weaken and lose tropical characteristics during the next 36 to 48 hours, but will remain a threat to shipping.

Tropical Storm Isidore, with 70 mph winds, is centered 1260 miles south southwest of the Azores, moving north northeast at 14 mph. A turn more to the north will likely occur this period as the storm continues to weaken, threatening only shipping.

Tropical Storm Genevieve is nearly stationary in the eastern Pacific near 15.7n/116.5w, and is expected to begin to drift to the northwest this period. Top winds, now 50 mph, will begin to drop off as the storm weakens, making it a moderate threat only to shipping.
